description: adws/adw_interface_live_finance.py -- the five-phase workflow this agent exists to run. Matches the question against its installed ILiveQuestion registry, resolves the organization by organizations.type, runs one read-only SELECT, and has the question read its own rows back as one line. Never invents a figure: an unmatched question reports that no figure was read and names the questions that ARE installed. --list-questions touches no database. Reports through --message-out, which is the contract this agent reads.
